stem:
Hot dogs and bags of popcorn were sold at a concession stand. One family paid $8.00 for 2 hot dogs and 3 bags of popcorn. Another family paid $16.50 for 5 hot dogs and 4 bags of popcorn.

Which system of equations can be used to determine the price in dollars of a hot dog, x, and the price in dollars of a bag of popcorn, y?
